For a 50-person Indian company, I’d narrow the buying list to these three:

Provider	Cost / availability	Cancellation & support
Thomas Cook India Business Travel	Quote-based; India-wide corporate operation, including SMEs. 
Thomas Cook
+1
	Air/hotel/rail/car changes follow supplier rules; dedicated 24/7 emergency desk and configurable servicing. 
Thomas Cook

FCM Travel India	Quote-based; India presence and specialist SME coverage through Corporate Traveller. 
FCM Travel
	Supplier-specific cancellation/reissue terms; 24/7 support, travel-risk management and dedicated account management. 
FCM Travel

American Express GBT	Quote-based; corporate travel platform with tailored service levels. 
American Express
	Cancellation depends on airline/hotel; support infrastructure is strong. Its India Business Travel Account can centralise air spend, with up to 51 days payment period. 
American Express

What to request before choosing: a 12-month all-in quote showing booking fees, hotel markups, GST, cancellation/reissue fees, implementation charges and minimum spend. None publishes a directly comparable 50-person price, so advertised “cheap” transaction fees alone won't establish total cost.

Three suitable 5-day Kerala packages from Mumbai:

TravelTriangle – ₹21,500/person: 4N/5D, Munnar + Thekkady + Alleppey, 4-star hotels, breakfast, sightseeing and transfers. Good balanced itinerary. 
TravelTriangle.com

MakeMyTrip – ₹13,718/person: 4N/5D, Munnar + Thekkady + Alleppey, 3/4-star hotels, intercity transfers, airport pickup/drop and selected meals. Budget-focused. 
MakeMyTrip

Honor Tour & Travels – ₹35,000/person: 5D/4N Kochi + Munnar + Thekkady + Alleppey, hotels, meals and all transfers; Mumbai departures available. Best for covering more of Kerala in five days. 
honortourandtravels.com

Key difference: MakeMyTrip prioritises price, TravelTriangle offers a mid-range 4-star balance, while Honor covers the most destinations with an all-inclusive group format. Prices can change by date and occupancy.
